fact_text: OGDC is described as Pakistan's largest oil and gas exploration and production company, producing roughly half of the country's crude oil and about 30% of its natural gas.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGDC's main producing fields include the Nashpa, Uch, Qadirpur and Tal blocks.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGDC holds a 20% stake in Mari Energies, which the analyst values separately from OGDC's core upstream earnings so the stake is not counted twice.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGDC holds a 65% working interest in the Nashpa block, so it captures most of the direct benefit from any production increase there.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A successful well's return on capital is its annual per-well profit divided by the all-in cost of one successful well, which is total exploration spend divided by the number of discoveries.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst uses Pakistan's long-term average exploration success rate of about 37% rather than a higher recent hit rate, to stay conservative when valuing exploration returns.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Upstream oil and gas is globally capital-intensive and risky, but low salary and operating costs in dollar terms make Pakistani producers' returns attractive in the analyst's view.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's petroleum policy links upstream oil and gas prices to dollar and international benchmarks, so producer realisations move with global prices and the exchange rate.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGDC's trade debts rose from about PKR 55 billion in 2013 to about PKR 635 billion by 2024, so roughly PKR 600 billion of about PKR 1,000 billion cumulative profit over 11 years was not received on time.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Delayed collections cut OGDC's reinvestment capacity, so drilling fell and production began to decline, which the analyst sees as the main reason the stock lagged for about a decade.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Circular debt works as a chain: late payments to producers cut their cash flow, which reduces reinvestment in wells, then output, and the share price prices in the slowdown.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Exploration and development wells drilled in Pakistan fell from about 100 a year around 2012-13 to roughly 35-40 a year by 2023-24 as circular debt constrained spending.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGDC traded at about 10-12 times earnings around 2006-07, a premium to the market, reflecting the high-return nature of its business before circular debt weighed on it.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Under IMF conditions in 2023-24, steps were taken in the gas sector to control circular debt, after which OGDC's cash profits improved and some older receivables began to be collected.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: After the 2025 India-Pakistan conflict, Pakistan's geopolitical position improved and interest rates fell, and the market moved sideways before a strong rally from July 2025; the analyst sees similar conditions possibly repeating.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: OGDC announced two significant discoveries at the Barjai well in the Nashpa block in January 2026, which the analyst calls its biggest recent discovery.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The two Barjai discoveries together were reported at about 7,200 barrels of oil per day and 18 mmcfd of gas, according to the analyst.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A new discovery is valued by converting its added earnings into a per-share uplift and applying a conservative P/E of about 8 times to that increase.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's FY27 estimates exclude the full Nashpa production uplift, which is expected to start in FY28.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's FY27 base case assumes $80 per barrel crude, about 42,000-44,000 barrels per day of oil and 650 mmcfd of gas, giving revenue of roughly PKR 460-470 billion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: From that FY27 base case the analyst estimates OGDC earnings per share at roughly PKR 37-40.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects FY27 dividends in the PKR 16-20 per share range, supported by OGDC's strong cash profits.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The petroleum policy sets a 35% tax rate for upstream oil and gas; after a January 2026 Federal Constitutional Court decision, producers aligned with that rate, and the analyst notes Mari Energies reversed earlier super-tax charges.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2026 reduced the super tax for companies generally, which the analyst credits with raising reported corporate profits.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The FY27 budget did not cut the super tax for oil and gas exploration companies, which instead follow the petroleum policy rate.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Domestic crude and gas production offsets oil imports, so new discoveries also reduce the national import bill.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When comparing two upstream names, split the market-cap gap into the value of listed stakes, the balance-sheet net cushion, and the extra earnings capitalised at a P/E, then test whether the gap is covered.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst capitalises extra upstream earnings at about 7 times P/E when sizing a valuation gap between two producers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues OGDC's larger crude sales mix gives it a higher chance of converting profits into cash than PPL, and that OGDC's advantages more than offset the valuation gap between them.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst notes PPL's mining project is at a more advanced stage than OGDC's, which is a point in PPL's favour in the comparison.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'OGDC vs PPL: Which Stock Is Better for 2027?' (YouTube transcript, undated)
